description: Opens a DIYA-GL book saved in the person's DIY Accounting Submit account by its bookId, which list_books gives (a practice client's own DIYA-GL book with clientId). Answers the product, the business, the period covered, the line count and the book's checks, and replaces any DIYA-GL book already open in this conversation. Use this when the person picks a saved DIYA-GL book, or before working out or preparing a VAT return from their records. It does not change the book, file anything or contact HMRC.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to open that client's book instead of the practice's own

name: open_book
title: Open a DIYA-GL book
